players.product: 300-millimeter FD-SOI silicon fab environment for Quobly silicon-based quantum computers

connects_to.relationship: 300-millimeter FD-SOI silicon fab environment for Quobly quantum processors

contracts.signal: STMicroelectronics (management, Q2 call): ST is leveraging years of shared FD-SOI expertise and deep technological collaboration to accelerate the commercialization of Quobly's products through its 300-millimeter silicon fab environment; Quobly aims to bring its first commercial silicon-based quantum computer to market by the end of 2026.
